summary: This bill requires the Department of Veterans Affairs to formally recognize veteran caregivers in health records, notify veterans and caregivers of clinical determinations regarding caregiver program eligibility, and temporarily extend benefits for veterans found ineligible for the family caregiver program for at least 90 days after notification.
